30–60 min (plus the time to get the Nomad Parchment)

{npc:Arito}, a shop owner in Ankrahmun, used to be a nomad and his name appears on a Nomads blacklist. You open the secret entrance to the Nomad Cave with a scimitar and water, talk to the chief {npc:Muhad} so that he forgives Arito, and return with the good news. You receive 50 {item:Platinum Coin|Platinum Coins}.
Have a {item:Nomad Parchment} and talk to Arito **before** trying to enter the cave.
very rare drop from Nomads (or buy it from another player)
one per player, lost when you open the entrance
When you start the quest: talk to {npc:Arito} with a {item:Nomad Parchment} and open the secret entrance with a scimitar and water.
After the quest you can only go back into the cave (through the back entrance) to hunt Nomads if you agreed to help {npc:Muhad} in the {wiki:Nomads Land Quest|Nomads Land Quest}.
In step 3, when {npc:Muhad} asks if you want to help the tribe, answer {key:yes}.
The Nomads Land Quest requires you to have finished this quest.
The {item:Nomad Parchment} has a very low drop rate: buying it from another player can save a lot of time.
In a group, each player needs their own {item:Scimitar}: the entrance closes after one player goes through.
At night a {creature:Werehyaena} also appears in the area.
Kill {creature:Nomad (Basic)|Nomads} until you get a {item:Nomad Parchment} (the nomads' blacklist), or buy it from another player.

Go to **Ankrahmun** (by boat: tell your city's captain {key:hi}, {key:ankrahmun}, {key:yes}; you arrive at {npc:Captain Sinbeard}'s port) and talk to {npc:Arito}. Say {key:hi}, {key:nomads} and {key:yes}. He tells you he used to be a nomad and explains how to get into their hideout.
If you try to enter the cave without having talked to Arito, you don't get in and you lose the scimitar and the water.

From Ankrahmun, head **north** along the mountain pass that links **Ankrahmun** to **Darashia**. The entrance is just **east** of that pass, in a small cave in the mountains with a rock in the middle. There is a crack in the ground.
Place the scimitar and the water
Place the {item:Scimitar} on the crack tile. Then pour the {item:Water (Liquid)|water} on the tile **2 tiles to the right** of it. A gate appears.
After one player goes in, the gate closes. Each player in the group needs a new scimitar.

Go through the gate: you are in a small cave with a teleport. Step into it and you reach a much bigger cave, just below, full of {creature:Nomad (Basic)|Nomads} and {creature:Scorpion|Scorpions}. Further on there are lots of {creature:Rotworm|Rotworms} and {creature:Carrion Worm|Carrion Worms}.
Deep in the cave is the chief, {npc:Muhad}. Say {key:hi}, {key:Arito} and {key:yes}. He agrees to pardon Arito and asks whether you want to help the tribe on another mission.
If you say {key:yes} to this last question, you start the {wiki:Nomads Land Quest|Nomads Land Quest}. Only those who agree to help Muhad can re-enter through the back door to hunt Nomads.

Go up the stairs behind Muhad (the back entrance), so you don't have trouble with the nomads. The back door corresponds to the second entrance of the {wiki:Nomad Cave}, a hidden hole in the desert near the first entrance ({coord:33214,32553,7}); keep the {item:Rope} (quest equipment) at hand to climb to the surface. To get back in this way later you have to dig the hole with a {item:Shovel} (sometimes you need to dig several times on the right tile) and the door inside only opens after you finish this quest.
Exit through the back of the Nomad Cave
Second (back) entrance of the Nomad Cave, in the desert
From the desert, go back **south** along the mountain pass to **Ankrahmun** and talk to {npc:Arito}: {key:hi}, {key:yes} and {key:acquitted}.
After this quest you can only return to the Nomad Cave (through the back entrance) to hunt Nomads if you agreed to help Muhad in the {wiki:Nomads Land Quest|Nomads Land Quest}.
